newsitem.title: USA: Chiron will not pursue license for herpes vaccine.
newsitem.headline: Chiron will not pursue license for herpes vaccine.

text.p: Chiron Corp. said Monday its test vaccine for genital herpes has turned out to be a failure, sparking a major selloff of its stock.
The stock fell $3 to $18.875 on Nasdaq, where it was among the most active issues at midday.
Chiron said preliminary analysis of results from trials show the vaccine was not effective in preventing herpes, and the company will not seek a license for the product.
Chiron said further analysis of the trial data was under way and complete results would be reported "in appropriate scientific forums."
Chiron, based in Emeryville, Calif., is a healthcare company that combines diagnostic, vaccine and therapeutic strategies for controlling disease.
